title: Managed Backup: suspension grace
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines suspension grace.

## Tier basis

**Collection suspension grace period.** Calendar days after invoice maturity before collection suspension; integer.

| Contract tier | Collection suspension grace period |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 15 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, collection suspension grace period is 15.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, collection suspension grace period stays the same.
